powerConvention.method: Advance simulation/analytic approximation under the declared mixed-model structure; values are design-stage sensitivity bounds, not post-hoc power.
powerConvention.limitations: Exact mixed-model MDE depends on realised random-effect variance and event prevalence; all assumptions below must be reported with the estimates.

mdeAtN24.assumptions: 144 binary trials, two-sided alpha .05, 80% power, baseline success probability .50, participant ICC .20, balanced condition/task/position.

confirmatoryTests.dispersionSwitchRule: Fit the declared Poisson model first. If a likelihood-ratio dispersion test rejects equidispersion at alpha .05, refit the identical fixed/random-effect formula with a negative-binomial distribution and report the dispersion estimate and switch.

mdeAtN24.assumptions: 96 count trials, two-sided alpha .05, 80% power, reference mean .50 errors/trial, participant ICC .20; overdispersion would increase this MDE.

confirmatoryTests.incompleteFactorial: Each participant contributes one N=1 and one N=3 observation on different tasks. The candidateCount-by-task interaction is not estimable within participant, and no paired comparison may be reported as if task were controlled.
confirmatoryTests.powerWarning: With 48 binary observations this is the least-powered confirmatory hypothesis.
confirmatoryTests.estimand: candidate-count odds ratio adjusted only for the declared task and order terms

mdeAtN24.assumptions: 48 binary observations, two-sided alpha .05, 80% power, reference acceptance probability .50, participant ICC .15, balanced candidate-count order; incomplete task crossing retained.

estimationAnalyses.model: ordinal mixed model with participant random intercept
estimationAnalyses.estimand: every pairwise mode contrast with 90% confidence intervals

equivalenceTest.decisionRule: The sensitivity TOST clears only if the 90% CI for every pairwise interaction-mode contrast lies entirely inside [-0.5, +0.5] scale points. It does not restore confirmatory status.
equivalenceTest.marginRationale: Half a point on a 7-point scale is below the resolution at which a participant meaningfully distinguishes about right from slightly off, so a smaller difference is not a behavioural change worth claiming.
equivalenceTest.marginRevisionRationale: No margin revision is proposed. The substantive +/-0.5 boundary remains unchanged pending investigator sign-off and was not widened in response to power.
equivalenceTest.nullWarning: A non-significant difference is not evidence of stability.

varianceDecomposition.trialLevelSource: Declared planning assumption; no task-matched pilot estimate or directly applicable prior-literature variance component was available before data collection.
varianceDecomposition.stableParticipantByModeSource: Declared planning assumption; no task-matched pilot estimate or directly applicable prior-literature variance component was available before data collection.
varianceDecomposition.interpretation: Averaging two trials per mode halves only trial-level variance. Stable participant-by-mode variance is not reduced.

equivalencePowerAtN24.planningMethod: Fixed-variance normal per-contrast power approximation using t(.95,23)=1.714 as the 90% CI critical value, true contrast=0, and power=max(0, 2*Phi(margin/SE-critical)-1). The confirmatory rule requires the intersection of all ten contrast events, so its power cannot exceed per-contrast power.

unaveragedReading.interpretation: With all 1.45 SD treated as stable contrast variance, the 90% CI cannot fit inside +/-0.5 even at a perfectly null point estimate.

twoTrialPairAverageReading.jointPowerCaveat: The ten pairwise contrasts are correlated, so the independence value is a reference rather than an exact joint-power claim. The rigorous intersection upper bound is the per-contrast 35.94150512%, already below the eligibility threshold.
twoTrialPairAverageReading.interpretation: The pair average is geometrically capable of clearing the margin, but both per-contrast power and the rigorous upper bound on simultaneous ten-contrast power remain below 50%.

confirmatoryEligibilityRule.rule: If advance equivalence power at the unchanged +/-0.5 margin is below 50%, remove H3 from confirmatoryTests, report H3 as estimation with 90% CIs, label it non-confirmatory, and report the TOST only as a sensitivity analysis.
confirmatoryEligibilityRule.branchReason: Declared two-trial pair-average per-contrast power is 35.94150512%, which is also an upper bound on power for all ten contrasts clearing simultaneously and is below the 50% threshold. This branch is fixed before participant data and is not selected from the observed outcome.

mdeAtN24.assumptions: Two-sided alpha .05, 80% power, pair-average SD 1.1231651704 scale points under the declared 80/20 variance split; this difference MDE is not an equivalence margin.

secondaryMeasures.reportingRule: Report effect sizes and confidence intervals. No secondary measure may be promoted to confirmatory after data inspection.

predeclaredRules.decision: If dryRunManipulationCheck discrimination is at chance across participants, log-derived H2 measures carry H2 and validatedExecutionConfidence is reported as exploratory.

unusableTrialRules: Exclude a trial from its outcome analysis if no study_trial_started event or no terminal study_trial_ended/study_trial_partial marker can be joined.
Exclude instrument-specific outcomes when the measurement channel failed before a response could be recorded; retain other valid outcomes from that trial.
Never exclude a trial because its outcome is poor, slow, rejected, timed out, or contrary to a hypothesis.
exclusions.partialTrials: Retain completed measurements, mark the trial partial, and exclude only outcomes whose required endpoint was not reached.
exclusions.timeouts: Retain as trialEndReason=timeout and taskCompletion=false; do not recode as missing or success.
exclusions.declinedQuestionnaireResponses: Retain response='declined', score as missing for that item, and do not impute.
exclusions.withdrawal: Remove all participant-linked records when withdrawal is requested; do not replace the participant after the preregistered stopping rule unless an amendment is recorded.

multiplicity.primaryRule: Holm correction across the three confirmatory hypothesis-level p-values H1, H2, and H4 at family-wise alpha .05. H3 is excluded from the confirmatory family by its predeclared below-50%-equivalence-power rule.
multiplicity.secondaryRule: Secondary measures are exploratory, carry no significance claim, and are reported with effect sizes and confidence intervals. If an explicitly named secondary family is tested, use Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=.05 and label it exploratory.

asrGuardReporting: Report ASR confidence, word count, and transcription-error rate by condition alongside H1. Do not add ASR confidence as a post-hoc H1 covariate.
